profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ American Express
profile.summary:
Former Software Engineer II at General Motors, engineered and deployed Full-Stack Open Social Gadgets using Java (Spring Boot) and Javascript, automating tasks within IBM's toolsets to enhance operations and productivity. Developed and integrated new features into automation tools, driving efficiency gains and functionality across multiple projects. Ensured stability and reliability of critical tools through proactive bug-fixing and issue resolution.

Graduated from Arizona State University with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (Software Engineering) in May 2020. During my studies, I gained valuable experience as a Software Engineer Intern at Choice Hotels International, designing and developing scalable data transfer and retrieval applications. Implemented extensive test coverage and created AWS lambda for server-less computing, contributing to efficient data management.

I have strong skills in Java, Spring Boot, and Object-Oriented Programming, with a passion for creating innovative and robust solutions for complex problems. My experience includes automating tasks, enhancing productivity, and driving efficiency gains across diverse projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
● Spearheaded the development of a reusable Database Connector library to standardize database connectivity and metadata extraction across multiple data platforms.

● Architected and implemented a Policy-aware GenAI chatbot end-to-end, enabling intuitive, conversational access to internal policies and knowledge bases.

● Conducted extensive research and POCs to explore and bring visibility to next-generation data platform capabilities, including OpenMetadata, GenAI-powered chat interfaces, database linters, and ERD generation tools.

● Focused heavily on rapid prototyping, iterating quickly on ideas to de-risk technologies, validate feasibility, and accelerate innovation within the organization.
positions.insights: Gen AI, Python (Programming Language) and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Engineered and deployed Full-Stack Open Social Gadgets utilizing Java (Spring Boot) and Javascript, automating tasks within IBM's toolsets, enhancing operations and productivity

● Reduce custom-built widget runtimes by over 80%, optimizing performance and improving user experience through researching and implementing new APIs

● Developed and integrated new features into automation tools, driving efficiency gains and enhancing functionality across multiple projects

● Ensured stability and reliability of critical tools through proactive bug-fixing and issue resolution.

● Led successful data migration from Rational Quality Management to new systems by engineering an export automation tool utilizing Java
(Spring Boot), minimizing downtime and preserving data integrity for over 80,000 test artifacts

● Engineered a Full-Stack error reporting and automated fixing tools, ensuring data integrity in test suites and providing real-time support for
error resolution for over 10,000 artifacts utilizing Java (Spring Boot) and JavaScript

● Initiated and built a ground-up internal platform with Java (Quarkus) and JavaScript (Angular) to host automation and migration tools, streamlining operations, facilitating task management and deploy to GM cloud utilizing the power of Kubernetes

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
● Designed and developed scalable data transfer application, monitoring team application health with a focus on seamless expansion

● Implemented automated data retrieval system using RestTemplate and HttpClient, ensuring smooth and reliable data flow from SonarDB to KairosDB

● Achieved extensive test coverage of over 90% using mockMVC and Mockito in JUnit tests, ensuring codebase robustness and reliability

● Actively contributed to user stories and modified AWS lambdas to meet evolving project needs

● Created lambda functions for independent services, reducing reliance on AWS instances for efficient and cost-effective solutions

● Developed comprehensive load tests and synthetic tests using JMeter, ensuring reliable performance in various simulated scenarios

projects.title: Cola Note
projects.description:
● Created a Full-Stack Application with JavaScript (Angular) and Java (Spring Boot) to facilitate team collaboration and streamline critical announcement visualization
● Integrated JSON Web Token (JWT) for efficient and stateless user authentication and authorization
● Orchestrated deployment on AWS BeanStalk to ensure a dependable REST API service for the frontend application
● Utilized AWS RDS (Postgres) as a resilient and scalable database, enhancing long-term data reliability and accessibility
